strategy.thesis: Corporate venture arm of Indian crypto exchange CoinDCX, investing in early-stage Web3, DeFi and blockchain companies globally, with a meaningful share earmarked for India to position the country as a global hub for crypto innovation.

summary.en: CoinDCX Ventures is the corporate venture arm of CoinDCX, India's largest crypto exchange. Launched in May 2022 with an initial Rs 100 crore (~$13M) fund deployed from its balance sheet, it backs seed and Series A Web3, DeFi and blockchain startups globally, with 30-40% of the portfolio expected to come from India.

strategy.thesis: Corporate venture capital initiative of CoinSwitch (India's largest crypto investing app) to invest in and incubate up to 100 early-stage Indian startups building Web3 and blockchain solutions, providing single-window access to marquee investor partners.

summary.en: CoinSwitch's Web3 Discovery Fund is the corporate venture capital initiative of CoinSwitch (India's largest crypto investing app), launched on August 9, 2022, to invest in and incubate up to 100 early-stage Indian Web3/blockchain startups, with single-window access to partners including Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Coinbase Ventures, Sequoia Capital India, Woodstock Fund and Elevation Capital, plus incubation partner Buidlers Tribe.

strategy.thesis: Venture arm of Korean crypto fund Hashed, backing the earliest stages of Web3 and AI-native startups from India and emerging markets, positioned at the convergence of blockchain and AI infrastructure (verifiable compute, on-chain data provenance).

summary.en: Hashed Emergent is the venture arm of Korean crypto fund Hashed, founded in 2021 and headquartered in Bangalore, India, with offices in Seoul, Singapore, Dubai and Lagos. It invests at the earliest stages in Web3 and AI-native startups from India and emerging markets, and describes itself as one of the largest India- and Africa-focused capital allocators for crypto founders.

strategy.thesis: Early-stage Web3 fund that began as the Polygon ecosystem fund and evolved into a multichain early-stage VC backing teams across DeFi, infrastructure, gaming, NFTs, consumer apps and DAOs, providing 360-degree operational and distribution support.

summary.en: P2 Ventures (formerly Polygon Ventures) is a $100 million early-stage Web3 fund associated with India-founded Polygon, headquartered in Bengaluru. Originally the Polygon ecosystem fund, it now invests across all categories of crypto/Web3 including DeFi, infrastructure, gaming, NFTs and DAOs, backing teams such as LayerZero, Magic Eden, EigenLayer, Polymarket and The Sandbox.

strategy.thesis: Thesis- and research-driven fund investing in early and growth-stage Web 3.0 companies and protocols across three megatrends: Convergence (Infrastructure / Web3 / AI), Financialisation (DeFi), and Virtualisation (gaming & creator economy).

summary.en: Woodstock Fund is a thesis- and research-driven Web3 venture firm founded in 2019 by Indian investors Pranav Sharma and Himanshu Yadav. Legally registered in the Cayman Islands with operations and offices in India (Mumbai) and the UAE, it invests $1M-$5M tickets in early and growth-stage Web 3.0 companies across DeFi, infrastructure and gaming. Portfolio includes Router Protocol, Covalent, Transak, Biconomy and Marlin.

Tracxn reports ~81 portfolio companies; fund size not publicly disclosed.

strategy.thesis: Technology innovation management firm running Web3 accelerator and developer programs in India in partnership with chains and ecosystems (Polygon, Hedera, NEAR, Binance, CoinSwitch) and the Government of Telangana, building a large Indian Web3 developer community.

investment.raw: grants up to $250K (PolygonLEAP); up to $9M+ follow-on potential

program.eligibility: Indian Web3 / blockchain startups and developers building on partner chains

summary.en: Lumos Labs is a Web3 innovation-management firm founded by Kaavya Prasad (founded 2018) that runs accelerators and developer programs for the Indian Web3 ecosystem. It launched PolygonLEAP 2021 (with a $250,000 Polygon grant pool and up to $9M+ in potential follow-on investment from Elevation, Lightspeed, Jump, Woodstock and Sino Global), the Hatch Web3 Accelerator for Hedera ($150K grant pool per edition), and the India Blockchain Accelerator with CoinSwitch and the Government of Telangana.

verification_notes: Lumos Labs operates an India-focused Web3 accelerator practice; it does not deploy its own venture fund — investment figures cited are partner grant pools and follow-on potential, not direct fund checks. Tracxn/secondary sources describe it as Singapore-founded (2018) but India-operating; classified under India for this India Web3 segment. Equity taken and cohort sizes vary by program and are not consistently disclosed.

strategy.thesis: Web3-focused accelerator for emerging markets, backing early-stage Indian Web3 infrastructure teams (DeFi payments, decentralised identity, real-world asset tokenisation, NFTs, GameFi) with seed capital, mentorship and access to global crypto VCs.

summary.en: Graviton is a Web3 accelerator for emerging markets that ran its first cohort in 2023, selecting 7 Indian startups from 350+ applications. It provides up to $50,000 initial investment, a 16-week program, mentorship and access to global crypto VCs, and is backed by 10 blockchain VCs including HashKey Capital and NGC Ventures.

summary.en: Buidlers Tribe is a Web3-native incubator started in 2021 by Raghu Mohan, Pareen Lathia and Kaavya Prasad to support emerging crypto-native Indian projects. Startups can access benefits worth ~$59,000 annually, and the incubator runs partner pitch sessions (e.g. with Coinbase Ventures offering up to $1M plus $25K grants) and serves as incubation partner for the India Blockchain Accelerator and CoinSwitch's Web3 Discovery Fund.

name.en: Blockchain for India Fund (WazirX x Binance)

strategy.thesis: A $50M fund jointly set up by Indian exchange WazirX and Binance to incubate and invest (in equity and tokens) in Indian blockchain startups solving industrial and social problems — fiat-to-crypto gateways, wallets, stablecoins, DeFi platforms and DApps.

summary.en: Blockchain for India was a $50 million fund announced in March 2020 by Indian exchange WazirX and Binance to invest (equity and tokens, $100K-$5M tickets) in Indian blockchain startups. Following the 2024 WazirX exchange hack and the strained Binance-WazirX relationship, the fund is effectively dormant.

sources.title: Binance Launches $50M 'Blockchain for India' Fund
sources.quote: Binance ... and Indian bitcoin exchange WazirX jointly announced a $50 million 'Blockchain for India' fund to support the development and growth of blockchain startups in India.

sources.title: Introducing Blockchain for India — $50 Million fund backed by WazirX & Binance
sources.quote: The fund will make investments in both equity and tokens, ranging from $100,000 to $5 Million USD ... fiat-to-digital assets gateway solutions, trading platforms, payment and remittance solutions, digital asset wallets, stablecoins, DeFi platforms, DApps

verification_notes: Status marked 'dormant' as inference: WazirX suffered a major hack in July 2024 and the Binance-WazirX ownership relationship has been publicly contested, so the 2020 fund is no longer reported as active. No public portfolio list of fund-specific deployments was found. WazirX founded 2017 by Nischal Shetty, Sameer Mhatre, Siddharth Menon.
